'''John Craig''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who is mentioned in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].

==Character history==
John Craig is an author with one of his books, [[A Few Good Hens]], seen on the beds of many [[Safehouses in GTA San Andreas|safehouses]].
